WineD3D is a translation layer for DirectX 1-11 إلى OpenGL.

DXVK is a translation layer for Direct3D 9-11 إلى Vulkan.

VKD3D is a translation layer for Direct3D 12 API إلى Vulkan.

CNC DDraw is an implementation of DirectDraw for better التوافق مع classic games.

Handling of flags on CALL/RET opcodes

0 : Treats CALL/RET as if it never needed flags (faster, unstable)
1 : Most RET will need flags, most CALLS will not
2 : All CALL/RET will need flags (slower)
استخدام of Float/Double for x87 emulation

Dynarec building BigBlock

0 : Don\'t try إلى build block as big as possible
1 : Build Dynarec block as big as possible
2 : Build Dynarec block bigger (continue when block overlaps, but only for blocks in elf الذاكرة)
3 : Build Dynarec block bigger (continue when block overlaps, for all types of الذاكرة)

Simulation of Strong الذاكرة model

0 : Don\'t try anything special
1 : تمكين some الذاكرة Barrier when writing إلى الذاكرة (on some MOV opcode)
2 : All 1 plus a الذاكرة Barrier on every write إلى الذاكرة using MOV
3 : All 2 plus الذاكرة Barrier when reading from الذاكرة and on some SSE/SSE2 opcodes
Defines the max allowed forward القيمة when building Block
Defines whether or not Dynarec will wait for the FillBlock إلى be ready

Tweak الذاكرة barriers إلى reduce الأداء impact of strong الذاكرة emulation

0 : استخدام regular safe barriers
1 : استخدام weak barriers for mild الأداء boost
2 : استخدام weak barriers, additionally تعطيل last write barriers

Generate aligned atomics only (only available on Arm64 for now).

0 : Generate unaligned atomics handling code.
1 : Generate aligned atomics only, which is faster and smaller code الحجم, but will cause SIGBUS for LOCK prefixed opcodes operating on aligned data addresses.

تمكين or تعطيل the استخدام of deferred flags.

0 : تعطيل the استخدام of deferred flags.
1 : تمكين the استخدام of deferred flags.

Allow continue running a block ذلك is unprotected and potentially dirty.

0 : Do not allow continue running a block ذلك is unprotected and potentially dirty.
1 : Allow continue إلى تشغيل a dynablock ذلك write data in the same page as code. It can gets faster in جارٍ التحميل time of some اللعبة but can also get unexpected crashes.
2 : Will also, when it detect an HotPage, flag ذلك page as NEVERCLEAN, and so it will not be write protected but Block build from ذلك page will always be tested. It can be faster ذلك way (but some SMC case might not be trapped).
تمكين / إظهار Adreno Tools on Unsupported Devices

تمكين or تعطيل the استخدام of native flags.

0 : Do not استخدام native flags.
1 : استخدام native flags when possible.

تمكين x86 إيقاف مؤقت emulation, may المساعدة the الأداء of spinlocks.

0 : Ignore x86 إيقاف مؤقت instruction.
1 : استخدام YIELD إلى emulate x86 إيقاف مؤقت instruction.
2 : استخدام WFI إلى emulate x86 إيقاف مؤقت instruction.
3 : استخدام SEVL+WFE إلى emulate x86 إيقاف مؤقت instruction.
تمكين experimental and potentially unstable Dynarec optimizations.
Optimize Dynarec for Java Virtual Machine (JVM) workloads.
تمكين TinyCC (TCC) integration for on-the-fly compilation of certain helpers.
Defines the threshold for HotPage detection in Dynarec.
استخدام faster but less compatible code generation for floating point operations.

AVX and AVX2 implemented, along مع BMI1, BMI2, ADX, FMA, F16C and RDANDR إضافة!

0 : تعطيل AVX إضافة
1 : تمكين AVX, BMI1, F16C and VAES إضافة.
2 : All 1 plus تمكين AVX2, BMI2, FMA, ADX,VPCLMULQDQ and RDRAND.
\
تمكين or تعطيل SSE4.2 instruction set emulation.
تمكين or تعطيل SHA instruction set extensions.
استخدام the futex_waitv syscall for better synchronization الأداء (requires Kernel 5.16+).
تمكين GDB stub for debugging Dynarec generated code.

Strong الذاكرة emulation per page

0 : معطّل
1 : مفعّل for code pages
2 : مفعّل for all pages
أقصى number of CPUs presented إلى programs حسب Box64

فرض every الذاكرة allocation in 32bit address spaces
Enables TSO IR ops (required for multithreaded apps).
Selects the FEXCore execution mode. 0 for JIT (fast), 1 for Interpreter (slow, more compatible).
Enables even stricter TSO checks. Only استخدام if standard TSO is not enough.
Enables symbolic SMC checks, which can be faster in some specific scenarios.
Enables rewriting of x86 ABIs إلى better match host ARM ABIs.
Sets the GDB port for remote debugging. Set إلى 0 إلى تعطيل.
Overrides the number of CPU cores reported إلى the application.
Spoofs the Linux kernel الإصدار reported إلى the guest (e.g., 5.15.0).
Enables استخدام of POSIX shared الذاكرة instead of SystemV.
Allows الذاكرة إلى be mapped as both Writable and Executable (W+X).
Forces Self-Modifying Code checks on all الذاكرة pages.
Makes vector load/stores atomic when TSO is مفعّل.
Uses half-barrier atomics for unaligned loads/stores under TSO.
Makes REP MOVS / REP STOS atomic under TSO.
Enables multiblock code compilation. Can cause longer JIT compilation and stutter.
Uses volatile metadata from PE الملفات for TSO when available.
Special SMC + JIT block hacks for Mono detection.
Hides CPUID hypervisor bit (useful for apps ذلك crash مع it).
Disables FEXCore JIT L2 ذاكرة التخزين المؤقت lookup, saving الذاكرة but introducing stutters.
Switches FEXCore JIT L1 ذاكرة التخزين المؤقت إلى be dynamically sized, saving الذاكرة but introducing stutters.
Emulates X87 floating point using 64-bit precision. This reduces emulation accuracy and may result in التصيير bugs.

If your اللعبة utilizes the XInput API for اللعبة controller support, please تمكين هذا option.

This option will affect both virtual (provided حسب الإدخال عناصر التحكم) and physical اللعبة controllers.

If your اللعبة utilizes the DInput API for اللعبة controller support, please تمكين هذا option.

This option will affect both virtual (provided حسب الإدخال عناصر التحكم) and physical اللعبة controllers.
Certain games like Rayman Origins and Need for السرعة: Most Wanted 2005 when using DInput require هذا إلى be معطّل.
Some games may support both APIs. Enabling both XInput and DInput simultaneously in such games may cause تحكم issues, as seen in titles like The الربط of Isaac and the Resident Evil series.
تحذير: Mixing gamepad and الفأرة bindings on the same controller may cause unexpected behavior in games. It is recommended إلى استخدام only gamepad bindings or only الفأرة/لوحة المفاتيح bindings.
